title: VPN Rotation Event
description: Per-attempt rotation record emitted by rev-stealth spider / cf-evaluate / relocate inside the vpn_rotation_events JSON array. v1.1.0 (P13).

attempt.description: 1-based attempt counter within a single request.

instance.description: VPN container / instance name responsible for the attempt.

signal.description: Outcome signal that drove the rotation decision.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent on this attempt, in milliseconds.

error.description: Optional free-form error description on failure.
